_doc: Copy to config/users.json (gitignored) and edit. Paths only: never put a password, holdings or tickers in this file. Each page is built and encrypted on its own (scripts/deploy_user.sh <slug>). Book CSVs: a 'Ticker' column, or headerless 'Ticker' / 'Ticker,Shares' / 'Ticker,Shares,Cost' rows. 'danelfin': true only for the owner's pages (Danelfin columns are stripped otherwise).
